goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): For the visible buy pad, pulse a green Highlight or neon glow and its price tag while the owner's Cash >= cost, and stop it when not affordable or after a buy. Count it in a 'highlights' census counter. When a player touches a pad with too little cash, flash the pad red, play an error buzz and show a short 'Need $N' toast without deducting cash. Hook into UpgradeService and UpgradeFx, and increment a pad_denied counter.. It has on-screen UI: use it like a player, through its buttons (`ui` + press): open its panel and press its action buttons (claim, buy, equip), and check what changed
summary: The playtester opened the shop, bought several items, and touched unaffordable pads, then bought Cash x1.5 through its pad. Probe counters show the feature firing: pad_denied=1, highlights=8 and pad_highlighted=1. The red flash, buzz and 'Need $N' toast are not visible in the truncated observations, so only the counters back them. The Cash x1.5 and Gold shop Buy buttons did not fire.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button on Card_mult1 (Cash x1.5) does not fire
bugs.evidence: Steps 8 and 9 pressed ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_mult1.State at 739,640 and both returned 'button did NOT fire'. The playtester's reasoning at step 9 says cash was above $300, but its note about $295 at step 8 conflicts with the flagged 331 figure. Card_speed1 Buy fired at step 7. At step 11 the same upgrade bought fine via the pad (step 12 HUD 'Upgraded: Cash x1.5'), so the shop button or its hit area is at fault.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button on Card_tier_gold does not fire
bugs.evidence: Step 12 pressed ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_tier_gold.State at 739,744 and got 'button did NOT fire'. The card may be clipped or below the visible scroll area of the list, or the player may have lacked cash. The cause cannot be confirmed from the trace.

bugs.title: No visible confirmation of the denied-pad feedback (red flash, buzz, 'Need $N' toast)
bugs.evidence: Steps 5 and 6 touched pads costing $150 and $300 with about $83 cash. The probe shows pad_denied=1, but the observations show no 'Need $N' toast. Step 5's touch is also followed by 'Upgraded: Dropper 3' in the step 6 HUD. It is unclear whether the first touch was denied or bought, and why pad_denied is only 1.

bugs.title: Tutorial re-shown excessively
bugs.evidence: The counter tutorial_reshown reached 22 during a short session, which suggests the tutorial prompt is re-triggered repeatedly and could clutter the HUD or UI.
